component.name: Deployd
component.summary: Linux-native mod manager for Bethesda and REDEngine games

description.p: Deployd is a Linux-native mod manager for Bethesda and REDEngine games, built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It integrates with Steam and Heroic Launcher, handles Nexus Mods downloads via SSO login and NXM links, and deploys mods as hardlinks for safe, non-destructive mod management.

ul.li: Supports Skyrim SE, Fallout 4, Fallout: New Vegas, Starfield, The Witcher 3, and Cyberpunk 2077
Game detection from Steam and Heroic Launcher (GOG/Epic)
Nexus Mods SSO login and NXM deep-link support
Install mods from ZIP, 7z, and RAR archives
FOMOD installer wizard with conditional steps and visibility rules
Drag-and-drop mod and plugin load order
Profile system for switching between mod configurations
External tool launcher with Wine/Proton support

screenshot.caption: Main window with mod order, plugin order, downloads, and notifications panels.

description.p: Prevents stale game loads from replacing another game's active profile, repairs AppImage NXM registration after data restoration, and reports expired Snap document-portal grants without presenting inaccessible official plugins as missing dependencies.
Improves Snap build reproducibility and AppStream metadata, and preserves installed-mod source metadata and deployed profile state during AppImage-to-Snap migration.

Improves long-running work feedback for installs, downloads scans, deploys, metadata fetches, and external tool launches. Downloads rows now mirror install phases, progress updates are throttled, vanilla plugin header reads are cached, and External Tools launches can be cancelled through Deployd-owned Wine/UMU process groups.

Polishes Mod Order header alignment, keeps the Downloads delete action visible in AppImage light mode, and improves Mod Properties and Install Mod dialog layout for large per-file target and conflict lists.

Multi-row selection in mod and plugin panels. Color-coded mod groups with palette picker. LOOT notifications as toasts. Conflict dot icon with tint; conflict count in the status bar. Filter empty states, enabled-mod tint, monospace paths, hover group highlights. Downloads panel: delete, hide, resizable sidebar. Notifications: clear-all, expandable rows. Removed experimental features (profile import/export, script extender launch, backup & restore). Snap packaging now on-par with AppImage (libunrar, feature flags, CI enabled).

Mod author now propagates correctly to the Mod Order panel after a metadata fetch. Scroll position is restored after mod list reloads. Introduces a drag dead zone to prevent accidental reorders. Download progress, deploy results, and install confirmations are now delivered as toasts. UI migrated to libadwaita 1.5 patterns. Fixes empty notification bubble, missing deploy toast, and metadata version race on install.

Adds mod name autocomplete in the Install dialog, a Compact Mod List toggle, drag-scroll in the Mod Order panel, stable named-mods by-name symlinks, archive path storage with reinstall button, and conflict detail in Mod Properties.

First stable release. Fixes Mod Properties incorrectly resetting per-file Root/Data deployment targets when opening the dialog. Adds per-file deselection checkboxes in the Install Mod dialog, making it easier to skip unwanted files before installation. The Install Mod file list is now taller and resizable. Adds The Witcher 1 (Aurora engine) and The Witcher 2 (REDEngine) support.

Fixes icons not rendering (missing SVG pixbuf loader) and theming not matching the host desktop environment. Overhauls the AppImage build pipeline to use a Docker-based environment pinned to Ubuntu 24.04 LTS for stable ABI compatibility.

Adds experimental Dragon Age: Origins support, FOMOD image previews, mod notes, a Replace option in the name-conflict dialog, download reinstall, and save/load order snapshots. Fixes drag-and-drop placement accuracy, list flickering, purge targeting, and many Dragon Age-specific issues.

Fixes MCM folder stripping during installation. Adds a notifications panel sidebar for external file changes and other alerts. Improves the headerbar layout with an overflow menu, and redesigns the downloads panel header.
Adds a notifications panel sidebar for external file changes and other alerts. Improves the headerbar layout and downloads panel design.

Fixes a crash when switching the downloads sort order while a download is in progress. Adds self-update support: when an update is available and deployd is running as an AppImage, a "Download Update" button appears in the banner to download and apply the update in-place.
Fixes the "Add a Game from Custom Directory" button and adds a visible Properties button to each mod row.
Adds SSO login for Nexus Mods, Steam library detection, and promotes REDEngine support (The Witcher 3, Cyberpunk 2077) to stable. Adds Fallout: New Vegas and Starfield support.
Includes Nexus Mods integration, FOMOD installer wizard, profile system, drag-and-drop load order, and REDEngine game support.
